question: Who among the following won the Booker Prize 2020 for his debut novel ‘Shuggie Bain’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Douglas Stuart**__.

__
 
• **Douglas Stuart **won the **Booker Prize 2020** for his debut novel ‘**Shuggie Bain**’.
 
• It tells the story of the youngest of the three children, Shuggie, growing up with his alcoholic mother, Agnes, in the 1980s,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Stuart (44) dedicated the book to his mother, who died of alcoholism when he was 16-years-old.
 
• After graduating from the Royal College of Art in London, he moved to New York to start a career in fashion design.
 
• He has worked for various brands, including **Calvin Klein, Ralph Lauren,** and **Gap.**
 
• He started writing in his spare time a decade ago. 
 
• **The Booker Prize**, formerly known as the Booker Prize for Fiction and the **Man Booker Prize ****and established in1969**
 
• **,** is a **literary prize **awarded each year for the best **novel written in English** and published in the United Kingdom or Ireland.
 
• The winner of the Booker Prize receives international publicity which usually leads to a sales boost.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Taylor is a right-handed batsman but is also an off-spinner.
 
• **Maaza Mengiste** is an Ethiopian-American writer and author of the novels Beneath the Lion's Gaze and The Shadow King, the latter of which was shortlisted for the 2020 Booker Prize.
